title: 老年醫學與家庭醫學
intro: 周全性老年評估、多重用藥、預防醫學與社區照護。 本科程序庫由課程工序生成，並標示為模板生成。
introEn: Comprehensive geriatric assessment, polypharmacy, preventive medicine and community care. This library is generated from the course steps and labelled as template-generated.

procedures.title: 周全性老年評估（CGA）
procedures.patient: 依課程「周全性老年評估（CGA）」設定的虛擬情境：功能、認知、情緒、營養、跌倒與社會支持。 本程序板以該課程的工序為站點；僅作辨識、判斷與交班教學，不提供真人操作參數。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual scenario for "Comprehensive geriatric assessment": Function, cognition, mood, nutrition, falls and social support. The stations are this course’s own steps; recognition, decision and handover teaching only — no parameters for real procedures.
